method_summary: fi-v12-1 with dictionary order unable to veto the gloss between analyses (headword or POS). Order still votes inside the gloss winner's analysis and confirms a gloss winner that is the first-listed analysis; a gloss winner elsewhere must beat every other analysis by 0.02 raw, or tie only with rivals of the same English (glosskey). A headword spelled like the surface (adv, intj, particle, pron, det) survives the tagger's POS and lemma gates as a candidate. Unresolved lines are still assigned as in fi-v12-1 (its dictionary-POS guard fires on correct menus); only a contested cross-analysis line abstains.

cross_analysis.why: Wiktionary orders analyses alphabetically and SpanishDict by page position; neither is a prior between headwords. Measured 2026-09-28 on the v15-mend and fi v12 runs: the provider-first veto caused 99.7% of cs, 75% of pt and 63% of es abstentions.
cross_analysis.margin_measured: Hand-read 15 vetoed lines per band per language: gloss winner right in nearly all cs lines at every band; es/pt about 30% wrong below 0.02 and 5-10% wrong at 0.02 and above.
cross_analysis.order_confirms: When the gloss winner is the menu's first analysis the line commits as under provider order; the margin applies only where the gloss overrides the order.
